payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about the requested move of the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
node.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. A mug on the right alone, or a source-location remnant together with a different or unidentifiable mug on the right, does not establish fulfillment. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Treat credible evidence of an attempted or incomplete move of the source mug as partial progress, even when its identity or final position is uncertain. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish either relevant progress or no progress, or cannot determine whether the requested condition is fulfilled; do not turn uncertainty into proof of no progress or complete fulfillment.
node.binding: Cross-image binding: the source blue mug and the same headphones in the source and edited images. Compare the source mug with visible edited mugs and assess their positions relative to the headphones. Consider appearance, scale, and other visual correspondence when determining whether a right-side mug is the source mug; inspect the source mug’s former location for evidence of a remnant or movement. Allow for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.

node_traces.evidence: The source shows one large blue mug to the left of the headphones. In the edited image, two smaller mugs are visible, one left of the headphones and one right, while a blue blurred shape remains near the source mug’s former location. The right-side mug does not reliably match the source mug, and the visible remnant makes a move plausible but does not establish whether the source mug itself was moved or whether the requested condition was fulfilled.

response.content: {"text":"The node’s criteria already distinguish uncertain identity from credible partial progress, but the trace appears to apply the stricter fulfillment test to the partial-progress decision: it treats the blurred blue remnant and changed mugs as insufficient to establish the source mug’s identity, then returns unknown. In these images, the source blue mug is left of the headphones; the edit shows a blue blurred remnant at its former location and mugs on both sides of the headphones. That is evidence consistent with an attempted/incomplete move, even though the right mug is not reliably identifiable as the original and completion is unproven. Clarify the decision boundary so credible evidence of an attempted move can support partial without proving object identity or fulfillment, while a right-side mug alone remains insufficient. Keep unknown for cases where neither progress nor no progress is supported. No transport, schema, or dependency failure is indicated; the issue is semantic routing between partial and unresolved, not a reason to force the reference label."}
